links.comparator_used: Default (vendor) AI score threshold, which gave ischemia sensitivity 59.2% and specificity 99.8%
links.outcome: Ischemia detection sensitivity on non-contrast head CT
links.effect: Sensitivity rose from 59.2% (95% CI 52.1-66.1) at the default threshold to 86.1% at the Youden-optimal threshold of 0.055; AUC 0.930 (0.906-0.954)
links.tradeoff: Negligible specificity loss reported. The threshold was derived on the same cohort, and the authors call for multicentre validation and site-specific recalibration.
links.quote: The Youden-optimal threshold (0.055) recovered sensitivity to 86.1% with negligible specificity loss, reflecting a markedly bimodal score distribution.
